units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 12b:18">Bekh. 12ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 18:15">Num. XVIII, 15</cite>) <he>לפ׳ הקשיתיו וכ׳</he> (the text) put it (the first-born ass) on an equal footing (with the first-born son) with regard to the duty of redemption, but to nothing else (any details of the law). Ib. I, 7 <he>מצות פ׳</he> the duty of redeeming; a. fr.—Pl. <he>פְּדִיּוֹת</he>, <he>פְּדִיּיוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 55b:7">Ber. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>שלש פ׳</he> three Biblical verses in which <cite ref="Q00111"><he>פדה</he></cite> occurs.
